Terms of use

Last updated 10 November 2026.

Who we are

This website is operated by Pillai Auto, an authorised dealer of Ather Energy Limited, with showrooms in Chennai, Chengalpattu, Puducherry and Chidambaram. By using the site you agree to these terms.

Prices and offers

Prices shown are indicative ex-showroom figures unless stated otherwise. They exclude RTO charges, insurance, accessories and any applicable subsidy, and they change without notice. The on-road estimator is an estimate and not a quotation. Nothing on this site is an offer capable of acceptance; the binding price is the one on your booking confirmation and invoice.

Specifications and range

Range figures are IDC-tested values published by the manufacturer. Real-world range varies with riding style, load, terrain, tyre pressure, weather and riding mode. Features and specifications change with model year and variant. Confirm the current specification with us before you book.

Introductory prices

Introductory prices, such as the launch price of the Ather Konarc, are set by Ather Energy and may be withdrawn or revised without notice.

Finance illustrations

The EMI calculator and running-cost comparison are illustrations. They are not loan offers, credit approvals or a guarantee of running cost. Pillai Auto is not a lender and does not provide financial advice; approval and terms rest with the financing partner.

“Ather”, “450 Apex”, “450X”, “450S”, “Rizta”, “Konarc”, AtherStack, Halo, Magic Twist, FallSafe, ParkSafe, LockSafe and all related names, logos, product photography and video are the property of Ather Energy Limited, and appear here in the course of authorised dealership sales. All other content is the property of Pillai Auto.

External links and media

This site links to and loads media from third-party services, including Ather Energy's media servers and Google Fonts. We do not control those services and are not responsible for their content or availability.

Liability

We take reasonable care to keep this information accurate but do not warrant that it is complete or current. To the extent permitted by law, Pillai Auto is not liable for loss arising from reliance on information published here. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited under Indian law.
